mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows, and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when GDPC1 shows upward trend over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers monetary tightening, increasing discount rates on equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns positive despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5% in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movements in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) signal robust demand, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST rising over next month
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not positive despite concurrent rises in GDPC1 and HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3% signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive despite FEDFUNDS <3% in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market stress, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns positive despite UNRATE crossing above 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate tightening labor and monetary policies, amplifying market uncertainty and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS rising over next month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not negative despite concurrent rises in UNRATE and FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained drop in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 95 signals supply-side weakness, reducing production capacity and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not positive despite INDPRO falling below 95 in post-shock regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing activity, enhancing corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive despite sustained upward trend in INDPRO over 6 months.
